name: CreatePortableBackup
transaction_boundary: snapshot/encryption/self-verification occur outside writer transaction; only fully verified publication is followed by one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork for completed evidence/audit
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay returns recorded artifact identity only when published artifact still matches digest; never regenerates/reveals recovery secret
receipt_order: initial idempotency check -> snapshot -> package -> disk self-verify -> final revalidation -> command_receipt -> completed evidence/audit -> commit
rules: recovery secret is generated independently and displayed exactly once
no completed evidence before authenticated database self-verification
